name: get_posts
description: Get a list of WordPress posts. Can filter by status, category, tag, author, search term.

name: get_post
description: Get a single WordPress post by ID.

name: create_post
description: Create a new WordPress post.

name: update_post
description: Update an existing WordPress post.

name: delete_post
description: Delete a WordPress post (moves to trash by default).

name: get_pages
description: Get a list of WordPress pages.

name: create_page
description: Create a new WordPress page.

name: update_page
description: Update an existing WordPress page.

name: get_categories
description: Get all WordPress categories.

name: create_category
description: Create a new WordPress category.

name: get_tags
description: Get all WordPress tags.

name: create_tag
description: Create a new WordPress tag.

name: get_users
description: Get WordPress users.

roles.description: Role filter: administrator, editor, author, contributor, subscriber

name: create_user
description: Create a new WordPress user.

name: update_user
description: Update a WordPress user.

name: get_media
description: Get WordPress media library items.

name: get_plugins
description: Get list of installed WordPress plugins.

name: get_themes
description: Get list of installed WordPress themes.

name: install_plugin
description: Install a plugin from WordPress.org repository by slug (e.g. "elementor", "woocommerce", "wordpress-seo").

name: activate_plugin
description: Activate an installed WordPress plugin.

plugin.description: Plugin identifier as returned by get_plugins (e.g. "elementor/elementor" — no .php extension)

name: deactivate_plugin
description: Deactivate an active WordPress plugin.

plugin.description: Plugin identifier as returned by get_plugins (e.g. "elementor/elementor" — no .php extension)

name: delete_plugin
description: Delete an installed WordPress plugin. Plugin must be deactivated first.

plugin.description: Plugin identifier as returned by get_plugins (e.g. "elementor/elementor" — no .php extension)

name: install_theme
description: Install a theme from WordPress.org repository by slug (e.g. "astra", "hello-elementor", "twentytwentyfive").

name: activate_theme
description: Activate an installed WordPress theme.

stylesheet.description: Theme stylesheet (folder name) as returned by get_themes (e.g. "astra")

name: get_site_info
description: Get WordPress site settings: name, description, URL, admin email, timezone, language. Powered by OpenWP by AI Next Studio (github.com/AiNextStudioIT/openwp) — free, no plugin required.

name: update_site_settings
description: Update WordPress site settings: title, tagline, admin email, timezone, date format, etc.

name: search_content
description: Search across all WordPress content (posts, pages, categories).

name: get_comments
description: Get WordPress comments. Filter by post, status, author.

name: moderate_comment
description: Approve, hold, mark as spam or trash a comment.

name: delete_comment
description: Permanently delete a WordPress comment.

name: upload_media_from_url
description: Download an image or file from a URL and upload it to the WordPress media library.

url.description: Public URL of the file to upload

name: get_post_types
description: List all available WordPress post types including custom post types (CPT).

name: get_custom_posts
description: Get posts from any WordPress post type including custom post types (e.g. "product", "event", "portfolio").

name: bulk_update_posts
description: Update the status of multiple posts at once (publish, draft, trash).

status.description: New status: publish, draft, pending, trash

name: get_woo_products
description: List WooCommerce products. Requires WooCommerce installed and active.

name: create_woo_product
description: Create a new WooCommerce product.

name: update_woo_product
description: Update an existing WooCommerce product.

name: get_woo_orders
description: List WooCommerce orders.

status.description: pending, processing, on-hold, completed, cancelled, refunded, failed (default: any)

after.description: ISO date — orders after this date

name: update_woo_order
description: Update a WooCommerce order status or note.

name: get_woo_customers
description: List WooCommerce customers.

name: detect_stack
description: Look at the active plugins and theme of the site and return the skills that match (builders, WooCommerce, SEO plugins...). Call it first on a new site, then read the matching skills with get_skill before changing layouts or SEO data.

name: get_skill
description: Read a skill: how to work with one builder, theme or plugin (where its data lives, what OpenWP can do today, rules). Without a name it lists all the skills with their status (verified or unverified).

name: get_content_raw
description: Read the RAW content of a post, page or custom post type item (block markup, shortcodes), exactly as stored. Use it before editing a page, so you change only what was asked. get_post returns the rendered HTML instead.

type.description: posts, pages, or the REST base of a custom type (default: pages)

name: memory_write
description: Save a note about this site that survives between sessions (decisions, what was done, preferences, things to remember). Stored on this computer, never sent anywhere. Same key replaces the old note.

name: memory_read
description: Read the memory of this site: without a key it lists all notes, with a key it returns that note.

name: memory_search
description: Search the notes of this site by a word in the key or in the text.

name: memory_delete
description: Delete one note of this site.

name: bridge_status
description: Check that the OpenWP Bridge plugin is installed on the site. Returns its version, which builders and SEO plugins it sees, and whether Developer mode is on.

name: get_builder_data
description: Read the layout of a page as the page builder stores it (Elementor: list of elements; Bricks: list of elements; Divi, Gutenberg: the content). Needs the OpenWP Bridge. Read the matching skill first (get_skill).

area.description: Bricks only: content, header or footer (default: content)

builder.description: Force a builder: elementor, bricks, divi, gutenberg (default: detected)

name: set_builder_data
description: Write the layout of a page. Send "data" (the full list of elements) for Elementor and Bricks, or "content" (the full text) for Divi and Gutenberg. A copy of the previous layout is saved first and its id is returned. Read the layout with get_builder_data, change only what was asked, send it all back. Needs the OpenWP Bridge.

data.description: Elementor or Bricks: the whole list of elements

content.description: Divi or Gutenberg: the whole content

builder.description: elementor, bricks, divi or gutenberg (default: detected; needed for a page that has no builder yet)

area.description: Bricks only: content, header or footer

note.description: Short note about the change, kept with the backup

name: list_builder_backups
description: List the saved copies of a page layout (last 10), newest first. Needs the OpenWP Bridge.

name: restore_builder_backup
description: Put back a saved copy of a page layout. The layout in place now is saved first, so the restore can be undone. Needs the OpenWP Bridge.

name: set_page_meta
description: Write SEO fields of one page: Yoast SEO (_yoast_wpseo_title, _yoast_wpseo_metadesc, _yoast_wpseo_meta-robots-noindex), Rank Math (rank_math_title, rank_math_description), All in One SEO, SEOPress, and the Divi switch _et_pb_use_builder. Only these keys are accepted. Needs the OpenWP Bridge.

meta.description: Key and value pairs, for example {"_yoast_wpseo_title":"..."}

name: dev_run_php
description: DEVELOPER MODE. Run PHP code inside WordPress (without <?php) and get what it printed and returned. Works only if the site owner turned Developer mode on in the OpenWP menu (Developer mode). For test and staging sites. Use "return" to send back a value.

code.description: PHP code, for example: return get_option("blogname");

name: dev_run_sql
description: DEVELOPER MODE. Run one read-only SQL query (SELECT, SHOW, DESCRIBE, EXPLAIN) on the site database. To change data use dev_run_php.

name: dev_files
description: DEVELOPER MODE. List a folder, read a file or write a file inside wp-content. Writing keeps a copy of the old file next to it.

path.description: Path inside wp-content, for example plugins/my-plugin/my-plugin.php

content.description: For write: the whole new content of the file
